competing_explanation: The 30-day figure may be outdated, may apply only to certain product categories, or may be confused with an exchange or store-credit window.
hypothesis_statement: H_J: The current full-refund return window for standard items is 30 days from delivery.
refutation_criterion: Counterfactual evidence shows the current policy specifies a different full-refund window for standard items, a different start date such as purchase date, or excludes standard items from full refunds.
